data.rationale: The proposal follows the same overall procedure and order (Wikipedia, timeanddate, Booking, Viator, OpenTable, Notes, Mail with discard), but it leaves out the review score of 8 or more filter, the second Viator search, the "do not click Reserve/Book/time slot" constraints, and the exact note and email templates. It also lists redundant parameters (dinner date and party size duplicate check-in and guests) and has no companion parameter, only a recipient email, so an automation built from it would need guesswork.
